roughness.method: Media de gamma0 VV (RTC, aplanada por terreno) en dB sobre la ventana 2400 m (240×240 px a 10 m, vecino más próximo); desviación típica 2.39 dB. Proxy de rugosidad superficial a escala de la longitud de onda banda C (~5.6 cm), no rugosidad geométrica medida. Escena única 2026-11-12, órbita descending.
roughness.credit: Sentinel-1 RTC (Planetary Computer, CC BY 4.0) · contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data

Copernicus DEM GLO-30 · tesela Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_S25_00_W071_00_DEM (Planetary Computer)

notes: El marcador de ARADS en data.js es orientativo; la ventana muestra el entorno, no el punto exacto de perforación.

Centro de la ventana elegido con scripts/analog_match.py: entre las ventanas de 2400 m a ≤ 5 km del punto de referencia (-24.102, -70.138), la de mayor índice geométrico frente a «Jezero». Es una elección reproducible del equipo, no un punto de ensayo publicado.

Alturas Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (modelo digital de superficie, alturas ortométricas EGM2008) leídas por ventana del COG, reproyectadas (bilineal) a una rejilla acimutal equidistante centrada en el sitio de 81×81 nodos a 30 m y remuestreadas a 65×65 a 37.5 m con terrain_metrics.bilinear_resample. Fila 0 = norte, columna 0 = oeste.
Métricas calculadas con scripts/terrain_metrics.compute_metrics sobre esta rejilla (elevaciones redondeadas a 0.1 m).
thermal=null: la telemetría meteorológica en vivo de la Tierra la aporta el backend (/api/telemetry).
La rugosidad radar (dB) es un indicador de retrodispersión, no una medida de similitud planetaria.

HiRISE DTM a 1 m promediado a celdas de 18.75 m antes de la rejilla de 37.5 m: la rugosidad métrica (rocas, megaripples) desaparece del índice geométrico.

decision.rationale: 1/2 planned stops inspected; coverage is incomplete. Complete or revise the traverse before advancing.
strengths: Regional terrain variation and a repeatable remote reconnaissance workflow.
Source-linked regional DEM and traceable stop coordinates.
breakdowns: Wheel traction, bearing capacity, small obstacles and autonomous perception require field measurements.
DEM elevations and slopes describe regional terrain; interpolation adds no detail. No sub-DEM rocks, safe zones or soil measurements are inferred.
Comparable topography is not planetary similarity or field feasibility. Earth gravity, atmosphere, radiation, water and biology differ from Moon and Mars conditions.
Rover motion, payload activity and battery use are illustrative SIM models; no spacecraft descent or target telemetry is generated.
nextSteps: Review the uninspected legs, revise constraints or acquire missing terrain data, then repeat the campaign.
Choose an independently documented planetary reference and audit scale, geology and environmental differences.
Confirm permits, access, field safety and instrument calibration with local specialists.

limitations: An Earth remote reconnaissance simulation, not a field visit or mission certification.
DEM elevations and slopes describe regional terrain; interpolation adds no detail. No sub-DEM rocks, safe zones or soil measurements are inferred.
Comparable topography is not planetary similarity or field feasibility. Earth gravity, atmosphere, radiation, water and biology differ from Moon and Mars conditions.
Rover motion, payload activity and battery use are illustrative SIM models; no spacecraft descent or target telemetry is generated.
Stop arrival tolerance (5 m) is a simulated position threshold, not DEM accuracy or an instrument footprint.

model.trace: The trace retains the latest 1500 positions sampled about every 8 m and the latest 100 session events; total SIM distance and elapsed time cover the full run. Trace sampling is not DEM resolution.
model.energy: Percent-per-SIM-second: (moving ? 0.0018 : 0.0004) × (1 + payloadKg/100) × (1 + slopeDeg/30) + (mobility ? 0.0001 : 0.0003). No solar recharge; uncalibrated editorial model. Drive-only estimate excludes operator dwell and instrument analysis.
